newsitem.title: USA: Human Genome files for 3.0 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Human Genome files for 3.0 mln shr offer.

text.p: Human Genome Sciences Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to three million common shares.
After the offering, outstanding common will total 21,814,564 common, the filing said.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 450,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co, Smith Barney Inc and UBS Securities.

Proceeds will be used to accelerate its therapeutic protein research and preclinical development, to expand clinical development, to fund the filing and prosecution of patents and to fund the operation of a pilot plant facility to be constructed.
Proceeds will also be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, the filing said.

Human Genome Sciences, based in Rockville, Md., is engaged in the research and development of novel, proprietary pharmaceutical and diagnostic products based on the discovery and understanding of the medical utility of genes.
